examples.chinese: 那麼我們現在去找他。
examples.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Let’s go ask him now.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳怎麼樣？你想再去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng zài qù ma?
examples.english: What do you think about that café? Would you like to go again?

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

examples.chinese: 那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
examples.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
examples.english: It is not mine. It is my elder brother’s. Mine is not in the living room.

examples.chinese: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I know a nice café. They serve delicious ice cream.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 那我這個週末一定要去看看。
examples.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhè ge zhōumò yídìng yào qù kànkan.
examples.english: Well then, I must see it this weekend.

examples.chinese: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
examples.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

items.wordHook: 日(sun/Japan) + 文(language) → the language of Japan.

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: 華(Chinese) + 人(person) → a person of Chinese ethnicity.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

items.wordHook: 䒑(grass top) covers 二(two) lambs grazing → one woolly 羊(sheep).

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 這個週末，我們要去湖邊烤肉。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò, wǒmen yào qù húbiān kǎoròu.
examples.english: This weekend, we are going to the lakeside to barbecue.

examples.chinese: 每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì wǒ shòubuliǎo gōngzuò yālì shí, jiù huì dào húbiān sànbù, kàndào píngjìng de húshuǐ, xīnlǐ jiù huì píngjìng xiàlái.
examples.english: Every time I can't stand the work pressure, I go for a walk by the lake; seeing the tranquil lake water, my heart becomes peaceful.

items.wordHook: a 氵(water) wave drenches a 胡(outrageous) dancer → 湖(lake).

examples.chinese: 下課以後，我要跟同學討論去日月潭旅行的事情。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào gēn tóngxué tǎolùn qù Rìyuètán lǚxíng de shìqing.
examples.english: After class, I want to discuss the trip to Sun Moon Lake with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 開會的時候，我跟教授的研究想法不同，所以我想跟他討論一下。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhou, wǒ gēn jiàoshòu de yánjiū xiǎngfǎ bùtóng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng gēn tā tǎolùn yīxià.
examples.english: During the meeting, my research thoughts were different from the professor's, so I want to discuss it with him.

examples.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bu néng gǎitiān zài shuō?
examples.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

examples.chinese: 這麼多問題，今天恐怕討論不完，我們能不能改天再說？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō wèntí, jīntiān kǒngpà tǎolùn bù wán, wǒmen néng bu néng gǎitiān zài shuō?
examples.english: With so many problems, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish discussing them today—can we talk about it another day?

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo xià xīngqīyī zài xiànshàng kāihuì, tǎolùn bàn yuángōng yùndònghuì de shìqing.
examples.english: We agreed to hold a meeting online next Monday to discuss the matter of organizing the employees' sports meet.

examples.chinese: 今天兩小時的會議，因為要討論的事增加而延長了三十分。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān liǎng xiǎoshí de huìyì, yīnwèi yào tǎolùn de shì zēngjiā ér yáncháng le sānshí fēn.
examples.english: Today's two-hour meeting was extended by thirty minutes because the matters to discuss increased.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 工會代表跟老闆討論工資問題，認為公司給的工錢仍然太低。
examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì dàibiǎo gēn lǎobǎn tǎolùn gōngzī wèntí, rènwéi gōngsī gěi de gōngqián réngrán tài dī.
examples.english: The union representative discussed the wage issue with the boss, believing that the wages the company offers are still too low.

examples.chinese: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu jiānchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, tǎolùn bù chū jiéguǒ, háishì zhǎo gè shuōhuà yǒu fènliàng de rén lái juédìng ba.
examples.english: In this matter, everyone insists on their own viewpoint, and no result can be reached through discussion; it would be better to find someone whose words carry weight to decide.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóshì zài guójì shàng xiāngdāng yǒumíng, tā de yánjiū zǒng néng yǐnfā xuézhě tǎolùn.
examples.english: Dr. Li is quite famous internationally; his research always sparks discussions among scholars.

examples.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
examples.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

examples.chinese: 他比一般的孩子聰明，所以學得又快又好。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ yībān de háizi cōngmíng, suǒyǐ xué de yòu kuài yòu hǎo.
examples.english: He is smarter than an average child, so he learns both quickly and well.

examples.chinese: 一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yībān rén dōu xǐhuān gēn xìnggé wēnróu, lèguān de rén jiāo péngyǒu.
examples.english: Most people like to make friends with people who have a gentle and optimistic personality.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo. “Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english: Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high. “Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē kǒuzhào zhèngmiàn gēn fǎnmiàn de chāyì hěn xiǎo, bùguò yībān lái shuō, zhèngmiàn de yánsè jiào shēn, fǎnmiàn de yánsè jiào qiǎn.
examples.english: For some masks, the difference between the front side and the reverse side is very small, but generally speaking, the front side is darker in color and the reverse side is lighter.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，到舞廳跳舞的多數是年輕人。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, dào wǔtīng tiàowǔ de duōshù shì niánqīngrén.
examples.english: Generally speaking, most of those who go to the dance hall to dance are young people.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，參加正式活動都得好好打扮，服裝也應該講究。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng dōu děi hǎohǎo dǎbàn, fúzhuāng yě yīnggāi jiǎngjiu.
examples.english: Generally speaking, to attend formal events one must dress up properly, and clothing should also be carefully chosen.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，手工做的麵包比機器做的好吃。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, shǒugōng zuò de miànbāo bǐ jīqì zuò de hǎochī.
examples.english: Generally speaking, handmade bread tastes better than machine-made bread.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

examples.chinese: 李小姐趁出國時，在機場買了一瓶有名的香水。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě chèn chūguó shí, zài jīchǎng mǎi le yī píng yǒumíng de xiāngshuǐ.
examples.english: Ms. Li, while taking advantage of going abroad, bought a bottle of famous perfume at the airport.

examples.chinese: 我想趁著暑假去旅行，你有什麼建議嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chènzhe shǔjià qù lǚxíng, nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì ma?
examples.english: I want to take advantage of the summer vacation to travel; do you have any suggestions?

examples.chinese: 時間很寶貴，我們應該要趁著年輕多讀書、多學習。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn bǎoguì, wǒmen yīnggāi yào chènzhe niánqīng duō dúshū, duō xuéxí.
examples.english: Time is precious; we should take advantage of our youth to read more and learn more.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 他剛去超市買了一把刷子，想趁週末時好好把浴室刷乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng qù chāoshì mǎi le yī bǎ shuāzi, xiǎng chèn zhōumò shí hǎohǎo bǎ yùshì shuā gānjìng.
examples.english: He just went to the supermarket and bought a scrub brush; he wants to take advantage of the weekend to scrub the bathroom clean properly.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 有張紙卡在傳真機裡，你拿得出來嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu zhāng zhǐ kǎ zài chuánzhēnjī lǐ, nǐ ná de chūlái ma?
examples.english: There's a piece of paper stuck in the fax machine; can you get it out?

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

items.wordHook: Possessing 強(strong) force burning with 烈(fiery) intensity: 強烈 means strong, intense.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

items.wordHook: The 酉(wine) 告(tells) you it is stylish and trendy, so it is 酷(cool).

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

items.wordHook: Combining 專(concentrated) and 心(heart): 專心 means focused.

examples.chinese: 這本小說是以愛情的題材寫成的，後來被拍成了一部浪漫的電影。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō shì yǐ àiqíng de tícái xiě chéng de, hòulái bèi pāi chéng le yī bù làngmàn de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This novel is written with a love theme, and was later made into a romantic movie.

examples.chinese: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gègèhánggèyè rénwù dāngzuò tícái de chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: He wants to write a full-length novel that uses people from all walks of life as its subject matter.

examples.chinese: 對他來說，這趟旅行的唯一目的僅是為了尋找畫畫的題材。
examples.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, zhè tàng lǚxíng de wéiyī mùdì jǐn shì wèile xúnzhǎo huà huà de tícái.
examples.english: For him, the only purpose of this trip is solely to find subjects for painting.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào jǐn gēnjù biǎomiàn lái pànduàn yī gè rén huò yī jiàn shì, děi huā shíjiān shēnrù liǎojiě.
examples.english: Don't judge a person or a matter based only on the surface; you must spend time to understand deeply.

examples.chinese: 天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
examples.pinyin: Tiāntiān shuō zìjǐ wàiháng, bù yuàn chángshì de rén, jiù wúfǎ gèng shēnrù de liǎojiě shìjiè.
examples.english: People who say they are laymen every day and are unwilling to try cannot understand the world more deeply.

items.wordHook: Combining 深(deep) and 入(enter): 深入 means deep, profound.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese: 要是你在百貨公司掉了東西，可以去服務中心的櫃臺問問。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ zài bǎihuò gōngsī diào le dōngxi, kěyǐ qù fúwù zhōngxīn de guìtái wènwen.
examples.english: If you lose something in the department store, you can go ask at the service center counter.

examples.chinese: 吃完飯到櫃臺結帳前，應該先看清楚帳單有沒有錯。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn dào guìtái jiézhàng qián, yīnggāi xiān kàn qīngchu zhàngdān yǒu méiyǒu cuò.
examples.english: After eating, before going to the counter to pay the bill, you should first check clearly whether there are any mistakes on the bill.

examples.chinese: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng rù huìyuán bìng xiǎngshòu wǒmen jiànshēnfáng suǒ tígōng de fúwù, qǐng nín dào guìtái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to become a member and enjoy the services provided by our gym, please go to the counter to handle it.

examples.chinese: 用過一面的紙張別急著丟，另一面也可以用。
examples.pinyin: Yòng guò yī miàn de zhǐzhāng bié jízhe diū, lìng yī miàn yě kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: Don't rush to throw away paper that has been used on one side; the other side can also be used.

examples.chinese: 昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān diànshìtái de qìxiàng bàogào shuō jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, guǒrán yí dàzǎo jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
examples.english: Yesterday the TV station's weather report said it would rain today, and just as expected, it started raining early in the morning.

examples.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
examples.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

examples.chinese: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xǔduō bànfǎ qù dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo, què háishì dé bú dào zhǔguǎn de zhīchí.
examples.english: I thought of many ways to achieve the company's goal, but still couldn't get the supervisor's support.

examples.chinese: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéxiào jiāng jiàoyù dàngchéng shāngpǐn lái mǎimài, dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhīchí.
examples.english: Some schools treat education as a commodity to buy and sell, but there are also people who do not support this.

examples.chinese: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā shīyè le, dàn qīzi sān rén què réng zài yīpáng zhīchí zhe tā, ràng tā ānxīn le bùshǎo.
examples.english: He lost his job, but his wife and three children still supported him on the side, which made him feel much more at ease.

examples.chinese: 公司全體都支持昨天公告的那條規定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī quántǐ dōu zhīchí zuótiān gōnggào de nà tiáo guīdìng.
examples.english: The entire company supports the regulation announced yesterday.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
examples.pinyin: Zìshā huòxǔ néng lìng gèrén bú zài shòudào tòngkǔ, dàn què bǎ tòngkǔ liú gěi le shēnbiān de rén.
examples.english: Suicide may be able to make the individual no longer suffer pain, but it leaves the pain to the people around them.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán shòudào le zhòngdà de cuòzhé, kěshì tā bìng méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Although he suffered a major setback, he actually did not give up his dream.

examples.chinese: 不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn wèihūn huòzhě yǐhūn de rén, zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng dōu yǒu xūyào miànduì de wèntí.
examples.english: Whether unmarried or married, people all have problems they need to face in real life.

examples.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
examples.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 工作有壓力時，應適當地分配你的工作及娛樂時間。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò yǒu yālì shí, yīng shìdàng de fēnpèi nǐ de gōngzuò jí yúlè shíjiān.
examples.english: When work is stressful, you should appropriately allocate your work and leisure time.

examples.chinese: 他對人很不客氣，因此大家都懶得理他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn bù kèqi, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu lǎn de lǐ tā.
examples.english: He is very impolite to people, so everyone cannot be bothered to pay attention to him.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 大學畢業後，同學們就奔向自己的人生目標，五年後才聚在一起。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè hòu, tóngxuémen jiù bēn xiàng zìjǐ de rénshēng mùbiāo, wǔ nián hòu cái jù zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: After graduating from university, classmates rush toward their own life goals, and only get together five years later.

examples.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
examples.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
examples.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

items.wordHook: 一(one) + 些(some) → 'one some' = a small, indefinite amount, like a handful of something.
Examining 一(one) distinct 方(direction) or side of a 面(face): 一方面 means on one hand.
Combining 全(whole) and 球(ball): 全球 means the world.
Combining 夫(man) and 婦(married woman): 夫婦 means couple.
Under the 宀(roof) a 女(woman) rests → safe and 安(peaceful).
工(labor) + 廠(factory) → a place of labor: 工廠(factory).
